_note: VFX socket rules for Modern Muscle: the Exotic rules (stage_b/data/sockets.json) with the Muscle template names. Sockets are computed from the thrust-channel parts of each module shape. A socket is an Attachment under ModuleRoot_DoNotRename; the flame runs along its local +Z. Exhaust axis of a thrust part: cyl_x/cyl_y/cyl_z = the cylinder axis; block and wedge = local Z.

engine._mergeDistance: Thrust parts whose centres are closer than this (single linkage) share one socket at their centroid.

stabiliser._mode: One socket per corner unit (Left/Right by X, Front/Rear by Z). When a corner has nozzles that point different ways, the group with the larger total nozzle area gets the socket.

_overrideTunnelRam: The computed sockets (yaw 35.58) do not survive Instance:Clone() bit for bit, so the installer's exact server and preview comparison failed in the Studio dry run (2026-10-04). Yaw 35.6 does. Positions are the computed ones.
_overrides: Optional explicit sockets per shape, replacing the computed ones. Example: {"Boost/bazookas": [{"name": "VFX_BoostJet_Back", "template": "BoostJet_Muscle", "position": [0, 0, 5.4], "orientation": [0, 0, 0]}]}
